title: Avesta's island continent that froze over
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Avesta's island continent that froze over, about ancient at Antarctica, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So in the Avesta it says that the the you know Arian the Aryan people uh come from an island continent at the center of the world which froze over

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani told podcast host Jesse Michels about a passage in the Avesta, the ancient holy texts of Iran's old Zoroastrian religion. He says the Avesta tells that the Aryan people came from an island continent at the center of the world that froze over, which he links to Antarctica. If true, it would mean an ancient people remembered a homeland now buried under ice.
